verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.parahelp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown pages. Multiple docs pages are served as raw .md (e.g. introduction.md, tools.md, quickstart.md), so an agent can ingest the documentation directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent bundle, and no first-party guidance or independent corroboration on using the docs with agents.
